title: App shell: main.dart, go_router wiring, session/lifecycle wiring, whole-app integration (Unit 1 shell half)
accept: main.dart boots ProviderScope + go_router app: launch → profile picker; profile selected → home/progress map; navigation exists to Reading, Collection, parent corner (gated) — the three pinned child-facing screens plus parent corner; route tests.

All cross-ticket wiring lives here (providers.dart): content_repository → phonics-engine → map; reading screen ← tracker + scaffold + audio + analytics; reading completion → celebration-sequence → return-to-map with next story highlighted; vocab opener injection; twister node → twister-flow (shell integration test drives one full story loop with all fakes: select profile → pick story → events turn words green → help fires → complete → celebrate → collectible → map).

Analytics session wiring: profile selection starts a session; app backgrounded > 120 s, closed, or profile switch ends it; reading-screen exit reports for story_abandoned (lifecycle simulated in tests).

Launch catalog check wired: online (faked) → catalog checked in background; offline_first_run_test: fresh install with airplane-mode fakes runs the full starter-pack experience end-to-end (Unit 11 acceptance, app level).

Child-facing navigation is icon + voice prompt only — no reading required to navigate: router-level test asserts child-facing routes' nav affordances are icon-based (voice prompt refs present as audio hooks).
No stock Material/Cupertino component styling visible in child-facing screens: shell applies the design-system theme; token-lint applies to lib/app/ too.

[DEVICE] Unit 1 golden acceptance routed to owner: goldens of library(map)/reading/collection in all four layout classes without overflow or clipped Rive stages; headless proxy: layout_smoke_test pumps each screen at all four class sizes asserting no overflow errors.
Existing test/scaffold_test.dart updated to the real shell (it currently asserts the placeholder).
pinned_design: Unit 1 pinned (shell half): Flutter, Riverpod state (A-2), go_router navigation, Rive runtime; child-facing screens are exactly Home/progress map, Reading, Collection; all child-facing navigation icon + voice prompt. This ticket owns main.dart and ALL router wiring (single-owner rule) and performs no feature logic of its own — it composes the feature tickets' public APIs. Session semantics wired per Unit 12 pinned boundaries; launch catalog check per Unit 11; celebration return-to-map with next story highlighted per Unit 8.
notes: Built LAST — it is the integration ticket. Everything headless with the fakes each feature ticket ships. If any feature ticket is quarantined, the shell wires the remaining ones and stubs the quarantined route behind a provider override (keep the loop green). Voice-prompt recordings are owner content — refs only.
